component.summary: Tasks, horizons, calendar, habits, focus, and plugins in one native app
Задачи, горизонты, календарь, привычки, фокус и плагины в одном нативном приложении
集任务、时间视野、日历、习惯、专注与插件于一体的原生应用

description.p: Fern is a fast, local-first desktop task manager and productivity suite written in Rust and rendered on the GPU with GPUI. No account, no subscription, and no cloud are required: your data lives in SQLite on your machine with daily automatic backups.

ul.li: Task lists, Kanban boards, timelines, nested subtasks, and natural-language Quick Add (English, Russian, Simplified Chinese)
Horizons panoramic planning across Today, Week, Month, Quarter, Year, Decade, and Life
Day, week, month, multi-day, year, and agenda calendars with two-way CalDAV synchronization
Eisenhower Matrix, Habit Tracker, Pomodoro & Stopwatch with Focus Mini window, Sticky Notes, and Life Clock
Sandboxed QuickJS-NG plugins, live-reloaded custom JSONC themes, and optional self-hosted E2EE sync server

screenshot.caption: Tasks view with Markdown details and checklists
Horizons panoramic planner across Today, Week, Month, Year, and Life
Calendar view with two-way CalDAV synchronization

description.p: Linux native polish release with Horizons, QuickJS-NG plugin ecosystem, Web preview parity, and multi-distro packaging (.deb, .rpm, AppImage, AUR, Flatpak, Nix).
